notes: Transcribed from sue604-evaluation.md §3.3 (unseen-topic holdout, no BEFORE baseline exists). A finding, not a FAIL: the causal explanation ("...그래서 지금 다 지어지는 집도 적은 거예요.") is introduced with "이상하게 보이지만 이유는 간단해요.", an added confidence marker present in neither the canonical source nor the sibling housing-report, which hedges the same proposition ("...과거 착공 부진의 결과로 **보인다**."). The evaluation does not call this semantic_integrity FAIL because the canonical view does assert the proposition as its own conclusion, but records the three-way confidence-level inconsistency across the batch as worth noting. Comparative dimensions abstain: not assessed by the source evaluation. comparison.mode is "abstain" and outcome is ABSTAIN where no language dimension failed: the evaluation this record transcribes assessed only the seven absolute language_quality dimensions and made no comparative judgement against a reference on any of the five comparative axes. Recording mode "pairwise" would assert a comparison that never happened, and a comparative PASS would claim the draft was measured against the reference and held up. The references are still named because they were the genre-matched pool available and a later comparative pass should use them.
